info.description: Hold the coin, get paid in stocks. The Index turns trading activity into real stock ownership. Every time $INDEX is traded, a 3% fee is collected in ETH and used to buy a basket of 18 tokenized stocks on Robinhood Chain. Those stocks are sent straight to holders' wallets — automatically, onchain, every 15 minutes. No claiming, no staking. The more the coin is traded, the more stocks the community owns.

Goldstein (GLDSTN) is the token of Goldstein Group, an on-chain investment firm on Robinhood Chain (chain ID 4663). The firm’s product is the G-fund: a token that holds underlying assets and can be redeemed for a share of those assets. Described fund types include a dollar savings token (gUSDG), leveraged long and short tokens such as gETH3x and gETH3xShort that borrow on Morpho markets and are rebalanced by a keeper, and basket tokens managed under published mandates. The firm is organized around 2,520 membership seats issued as NFTs. Seat holders can issue funds and receive a share of fees.

Bundlecat (BUN) is the first token launched on Mosh, a token launch protocol developed by UV Labs and deployed on Robinhood Chain. Mosh pairs new token launches with autonomous AI market-making agents. Under the Mosh model, token bundles are crowd-funded by participants and permanently locked in non-custodial smart contract vaults at the moment of launch. AI agents then use the locked tokens to provide liquidity and generate buy-side market activity, operating within contract-enforced rules that no individual, including the Mosh team, can override. Ravenhood is a deflationary token protocol built on Robinhood Chain. The project is centered on RVH, a fixed-supply ERC-20 token with protocol mechanics  designed around supply reduction, liquidity locking, and treasury development. Ravenhood uses permissionless burn mechanics that allow eligible protocol  actions to permanently remove tokens from circulation. The project also includes a website, swap interface, staking interface, burn dashboard, mindshare  system, and protocol documentation for users to follow token activity and ecosystem updates.

Robinhood MRNA is a tokenized representation of Moderna, Inc. (MRNA) common stock, issued on Robinhood Chain, Robinhood's own blockchain built to bring tokenized real-world assets on-chain. Each token is designed to track the price of the underlying MRNA share, giving holders on-chain price exposure to Moderna, Inc.'s stock. The token is freely transferable and composable across the Robinhood Chain ecosystem.
